title: Visits
description: How many people visit the site, what they look at and where they come from. Counted by the site itself, without cookies.

sources.title: Where visitors come from
sources.description: The site that sent them; “Direct”: typed in, a bookmark or an app that hides it.

privacy: No cookies and no IP addresses are kept: a visitor is an anonymous code that changes every day, so the same person counts once a day and can't be followed from day to day. Search engines and other robots are left out. Visits are kept for 13 months.
